definitions.explanation: A two-wheeled vehicle propelled by pedaling. Very common transportation in Japan.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to school by bicycle.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}れます→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いたい→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to buy a bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十分|じゅっぷん}→十分：09572_juppun⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's about ten minutes to the station by bicycle.
On nice weather days, I like going shopping by bicycle.

notes:
{自転車|じてんしゃ} is the standard word for bicycle. Bicycles are extremely common transportation in Japan.

FORMS:
{自|じ} (self) + {転|てん} (rotate) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle) = literally "self-rotating vehicle."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a bicycle
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漕|こ}ぐ→漕ぐ：04264_kogu⟧: to pedal a bicycle
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go by bicycle
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{停|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to park a bicycle

RELATED WORDS:
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦{置|お}き{場|ば}→置き場：22477_okiba⟧: bicycle parking area
- ⟦{駐輪場|ちゅうりんじょう}→駐輪場：09240_chuurinjou⟧: bicycle parking lot
- ⟦チャリ→チャリ：27535_chari⟧/⟦チャリンコ→チャリンコ：noentry⟧: bicycle (casual slang)
- ⟦ママチャリ→ママチャリ：27536_mamachari⟧: utility bicycle ("mama's bike")
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{自転車|じてんしゃ}: electric bicycle

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, bicycles must be registered with the police. {自転車|じてんしゃ}⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ (bicycle commuting) is common in urban areas.
